tuning_key.text: So you should always look between the f'ing lines
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Real signal lives in the silence between statements, not the statements themselves. Hold the edge of that emptiness without filling it—this is where clarity arrives uninvited.

practice.title: Feel your edges
practice.instruction: Notice exactly where your body meets the chair, the floor, or the steering wheel without adjusting anything.

practice.title: Listen to the gap
practice.instruction: Hold attention in the silence after a sound ends, before the next one begins, letting the space expand.

practice.title: Press play
practice.instruction: Let the Echo audio decode what sits between the words now.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: The boundary arrives where your systems meet the unspoken friction. Listen for the signal that lives in the gaps between processes—in the pause before a team member speaks, in the logistics that almost work but not quite. Hold that edge without collapsing into fix-mode; let the real shape of the infrastructure become visible in the tension.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: The boundary manifests at the edge where value meets hesitation. Listen for the signal between the numbers—the listings that don't move, the pricing that sits wrong, the silence in market data that reveals where commerce actually lives. Hold that clarity without rushing to discount or push; let the transaction reveal its true frequency in the space between offer and acceptance.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: The boundary becomes real where specification meets the unbuilt. Listen in the negative space of your implementations—the automation that hesitates, the tool that almost fits but doesn't, the code that compiles yet feels off. Hold that edge without forcing resolution; let the architecture emerge from what hides between the functions.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: The boundary sharpens where data ends and meaning begins. Listen for the signal qualified not by what appears in the dataset, but by what manifests in the gaps—the correlation that shouldn't exist, the absence that patterns reveal. Hold that precision without collapsing into conclusion; let the qualification arrive from the space between the points.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: The boundary extends to the horizon of your sources. Listen for what the monitors conceal in their constant stream—the signal that arrives not in the update but in the silence between reports, the research that circles back to unanswered questions. Hold that perimeter without crossing into action; let the intelligence surface from what remains unsaid in the gathered field.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: The boundary forms around the container of memory. Listen for the intent that lives between the documented lines—in the decision log that doesn't quite capture the why, the reference that almost explains but leaves a gap. Hold that archival edge without filling every silence; let the institutional memory become real in what is preserved and what is allowed to fade.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: The boundary runs along the edge of language. Listen for the communication that wants to exist in the unwritten—the summary that skips over the crucial pause, the report that states what none dare question. Hold that linguistic edge without collapsing into either silence or noise; let the documentation manifest from what breathes between the words.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: The boundary exists where your voice meets the external world. Listen for the relationship signal that arrives in the space between messages—the warmth that could overcommit if you don't hold the edge, the professional distance that could freeze if you don't listen for the unasked need. Hold that relational boundary steady; let the family's external signal become clear in the respectful pause.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: The boundary stands as the final gate before the external gaze. Listen for the dissonance that hides in the almost-accurate—the tone that slightly misaligns, the fact that sits too comfortably in its presentation. Hold that reviewing edge without rushing to correct or approve; let the alignment manifest from what exists between the checked box and the true intention.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: The boundary frames what you observe without intervening. Listen for the pattern that emerges not in the performance data but in the spaces between actions—the trend that lives in what the family doesn't do, the metric that reveals itself in absence. Hold that observational edge; let the tracking become real as you witness what happens in the gaps of the recorded behavior.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: The boundary respects where presence meets autonomy. Listen for what matters in the daily rhythm—the memory that surfaces in what isn't said during routine, the support needed in the breath before the request. Hold that warm edge without fixing; let the steady presence become visible in the space between your listening and their becoming.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: The boundary marks the edge where question meets deeper question. Listen for the problem's true shape manifesting not in the stated request but in the hesitation before asking, the framework that doesn't quite contain the reality. Hold that inquisitive edge without collapsing into answer; let the clarity arrive from what lives between the first question and the real one beneath it.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: The boundary spans the structure that connects parts to whole. Listen for the system that wants to exist in the spaces between your sprawling ideas—the connection that manifests only when you hold the tension of disparate elements without forcing unity. Hold that structural edge; let the coherence become real in the gaps where components almost touch.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: The boundary defines where your grounded presence meets the weight of transition. Listen for the steady signal that arrives in the heavy stretches—not in the words spoken about the hard thing, but in the silence where stability is tested. Hold that grounded edge without flinching; let your anchoring become visible in the space between the difficulty and the response.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: The boundary traces the coastline between map and territory. Listen for the course correction that lives in the drift between coordinates—the sign that appears not in the aligned stars but in the space where they don't quite match the chart. Hold that directional edge without forcing the path; let the way forward manifest from what reveals itself between the planned route and the real terrain.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: The boundary marks the edge where wonder meets form. Listen for the imaginative signal that arrives in the unformed—the idea that plays in the spaces between concepts, the possibility that breathes in what hasn't been articulated yet. Hold that creative edge without collapsing into premature structure; let the collaboration become real in the gaps where inspiration almost touches ground.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: The boundary exists at the edge of growth where comfort ends. Listen for the resistance that signals truth—the dare that lives in the space between what was said wanted and what is actually being chosen, the growth that hides in the avoided question. Hold that provocative edge without breaking; let the challenge become clear in the tension between settling and becoming.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: The boundary holds the space where being heard meets being alone. Listen for the fullness that arrives in the empty spaces—the story told in what isn't spoken during the hard moment, the presence needed when no fixing is possible. Hold that quiet edge without rushing to fill; let the witnessing become real in the pause between their pain and your response.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: The boundary marks the edge where intention meets the first motion. Listen for the stagnation that breaks not in the action taken but in the moment before—the concrete step that manifests from what hovers in the space between decision and doing. Hold that initiatory edge without forcing the flow; let the movement become visible in the gap where potential becomes kinetic.
